title: Mad Science
description:
Polymorphic event card that morphs based on TinkerTime mechanics. As Attack: Deal 12 damage. As Skill: Gain 8 [gold]Block[/gold]. As Power: Apply an effect based on its rider.

If the card has a Rider Effect, applies an additional effect:
• Sapping: Apply 2 [gold]Weak[/gold] and 2 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to a single enemy
• Choking: Whenever you play a card this turn, the enemy loses 6 HP
• Energized: Gain 2 [gold]Energy[/gold]
• Wisdom: Draw 3 cards
• Chaos: Add a random card into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn
• Expertise: Gain 2 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 2 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]
• Curious: [gold]Power[/gold] costs reduced by 1 [gold]Energy[/gold]
• Improvement: At the end of combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card

notes: Special Event card with TinkerTime mechanics. The card can transform between Attack, Skill, and Power types via the TinkerTimeType property, with corresponding target changes (AnyEnemy for Attack, Self for Skill/Power). It features a rider effect system (TinkerTimeRider) that adds additional effects beyond the base card type. Up to 8 different riders are possible. Not shown in the card library. Upgrade adds [gold]Innate[/gold] keyword, allowing it to be drawn at the start of combat.
